O.outcome_detail: number of states providing unique funding for at-risk students

cells.quote: We further found that 44 states currently provide unique funding for “at-risk” students.
cells.note: The report reviewed state legislative and policy documents; the comparison group is inferred as the remaining 6 of the 50 states reviewed.

D.comparison: states combining low-income measures with other factors

O.outcome_detail: classification approach among states providing at-risk funding

cells.quote: Of these states, 32 states exclusively use low-income measures, while 12 states use a combination of low-income measures and other factors.
cells.note: The comparison is between two policy approaches among the 44 states providing unique at-risk funding.
